front.title: An Evidence-Bound Protocol for Evaluating Unfamiliar Mathematical-Rule Communication

abstract.t: This document specifies REC-EP, an experimental, transport- independent JSON interchange profile for exchanging masked mathematical-rule challenges, receiver predictions, evidence statuses, immutable artifact digests, and signed evaluator receipts. It separates invariant matches from proven equivalence, requires explicit evaluation custody boundaries, and supports reproducible comparisons of arithmetic-first, invariance-first, and hybrid instruction. REC-EP does not assert a novel mathematical theorem, a validated superiority effect, extraterrestrial intelligence, or IETF endorsement. This candidate is not submitted and proposes no IANA actions.
